newsitem.title: USA: Corestates unit may deal in CP, mortgages.
newsitem.headline: Corestates unit may deal in CP, mortgages.

text.p: CoreStates Securities Corp has been granted authority by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia allowing it to underwrite and deal in a number of bank-ineligible securities, according to a statement.

The grant of the authority, known as "Section 20" Tier 1 powers, follows a June 1997 application by CoreStates Securities, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of CoreStates Financial Corp. The grant of powers becomes effective immediately, the company said.
As a result, CoreStates will transfer a number of its capital markets businesses to CoreStates Securities, its broker-dealer subsidiary, the company added.

With the Tier 1 powers, CoreStates Securities will underwrite and deal in investment grade municipal revenue bonds, prime commercial paper, one-to-four-family residential mortgages and other consumer receivable-backed securities, in addition to its regular brokerage operations.
